title: Local structure of a ring strict henselization
statement: Let A be a local commutative ring, K a chosen separable closure of its residue field, and C an A-algebra satisfying IsStrictHenselization A K C [def-sc-ring-strict-henselization]. Then C is a local ring, and its maximal ideal equals the ideal generated by the image of the maximal ideal of A under the structural map A → C. No Noetherian hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: Tags 04GP(2),(4) and 04GW, equivalence of pointed etale algebras and etale residue triples and uniqueness of their colimit

proof.text: Apply IsStrictHenselization.triples_presentation to obtain a point p with p.asIdeal = maximalIdeal A, the residue-field algebra and separable-closure instances on K, and a universal residue-triple cocone with vertex C whose legs preserve the given A-map. Apply Scheme.strictHenselization_triples to this same p and algebra structure to obtain a local universal cocone c and rho with maximalIdeal c.pt = ker psi = p.asIdeal.map rho.

Uniqueness of colimits gives a ring isomorphism e:c.pt→C. Evaluate its coprojection equation at the explicitly constructed identity triple (A,id,p). The structural-map compatibility of both cocones gives e.comp rho = algebraMap A C.

Transport the local-ring structure with RingEquiv.isLocalRing. IsLocalRing.map_ringEquiv_maximalIdeal identifies maximalIdeal C with the image of maximalIdeal c.pt. Substitute the two ideal equalities, p.asIdeal = maximalIdeal A, and Ideal.map_map; the structural-map equality from the identity triple proves the asserted formula.

proof_origin.place: Tags 04GP(2),(4), 04GW; second reading uses the existing triples-presentation theorem, uniqueness of colimits at the identity triple, and local-ring and ideal transport

lean.statement:
theorem strictHenselization_local_maximalIdeal
    (A K C : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A] [Field K]
    [Algebra (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) K] [IsSepClosure (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) K]
    [Algebra A K] [IsScalarTower A (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) K]
    [CommRing C] [Algebra A C] (hC : IsStrictHenselization A K C) :
    ∃ (_ : IsLocalRing C),
      IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal C = (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A).map (algebraMap A C)
